title: A finite surjective disjoint union of open immersions has a section
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $p:V\to Z$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] morphism. Suppose that $V=\coprod_{i=1}^nV_i$ is a finite disjoint union of open and closed subschemes such that every restriction $p_i:V_i\to Z$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $p$ has a section $s:Z\to V$ with $p\circ s=\mathrm{id}_Z$.

source.place: Lemma 59.80.6 (Tag 09ZA), proof, final paragraph: the finite cover by open-and-closed images is refined to disjoint clopen strata and the inverse open immersions glue to a section

proof.text: *The images are open, closed and cover $Z$ (Stacks: 'As $V\to Z$ is finite we see that $V_i\to Z$ is also closed. Let $U_i\subset Z$ be the image').* For $i=1,\dots,n$ let $k_i:V_i\to V$ be the inclusion of the open subscheme $V_i$, so that $p_i=p\circ k_i$, and let $U_i=p(V_i)=p_i(V_i)\subseteq Z$. Since $p_i$ is an open immersion, $U_i$ is open in $Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Since $p$ is finite it is a closed map (part (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres]), and $V_i$ is closed in $V$, so $U_i=p(V_i)$ is closed in $Z$. Since $p$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], every $z\in Z$ is $p(v)$ for some $v\in V=\bigcup_iV_i$, say $v\in V_i$, and then $z\in U_i$; so $Z=U_1\cup\dots\cup U_n$. In Lean, hcop makes Sigma.desc k an isomorphism; sigmaOpenCover covers the source coproduct, so every point of V lies in some range k_i. This uses [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family].

Refine the finite clopen cover U_i to pairwise disjoint clopens W_i contained in U_i with the same union. Explicitly choose an ordering and put W_i = U_i minus the union of the earlier U_j. Finite unions and complements of clopens are clopen. Every point of the union belongs to its first U_i, hence to W_i; membership in W_i excludes membership in any earlier U_j, so distinct W_i are disjoint. Lean uses Mathlib Fintype.exists_disjointed_le in the Boolean algebra TopologicalSpace.Clopens Z, followed by Clopens.coe_finset_sup to recover the union. This is the elementary refinement in the source, grouping the subset strata by their chosen least index; empty strata and an empty index type are allowed.

For each i, let O_i be the open underlying W_i. The inclusion O_i -> U_i is Z.homOfLE for W_i <= U_i, the special case of [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme]. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-iso-onto-image], pi_i.isoOpensRange identifies V_i with U_i. Compose O_i -> U_i with its inverse and k_i to obtain t_i : O_i -> V. Associativity, hpi_i, isoOpensRange_inv_comp, and homOfLE_ι give t_i composed with p equal to the inclusion O_i -> Z.

Assemble over the disjoint covering O_i by the coproduct universal property [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of (AlgebraicGeometry/Limits.lean:313) identifies the inclusion cofan with this coproduct: its sigma-desc map is an open immersion by disjointness, surjective by the covering equality, hence an isomorphism. Cofan.IsColimit.desc gives s with inclusion_i composed with s equal to t_i. By the computation of step 3, inclusion_i composed with s composed with p equals inclusion_i for every i. Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext therefore gives s composed with p = id_Z. This implements the disjoint gluing of the source without overlap morphisms or a separate empty-scheme argument.

split_report.summary: Split along the second paragraph of the proof of Stacks 09ZA (etale-cohomology.tex line 14390, label checked in tags/tags). Four steps: (1) the images U_i=p(V_i) are open (open immersion), closed (p finite hence a closed map, existing leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres (1)) and cover Z (p surjective); (2) the Stacks strata Z_A = ∩_{i∈A}U_i ∩ ∩_{i∉A}U_i^c, A nonempty, are open and closed, pairwise disjoint, cover Z, and Z_A ⊆ U_{min A} (elementary); (3) on Z_A the section k_i∘φ_i^{-1}∘ι_A with φ_i: V_i ≅ U_i from the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-iso-onto-image (Stacks 01HH; Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange) and ι_A from lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme; (4) gluing over the open cover {Z_A} (overlaps empty) by the leaf lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing (unit sk-thm-reduction, a Mathlib leaf hence a tool), whose uniqueness clause gives p∘s=id_Z. Statement unchanged; finiteness is used only for closedness of the images. lean.statement: theorem exists_section_of_finite_clopen_open_cover {n : ℕ} (Z V : Scheme.{u}) (p : V ⟶ Z) [IsFinite p] [Surjective p] (Vi : Fin n → Scheme.{u}) (k : ∀ i, Vi i ⟶ V) (hk : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (k i) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (k i)) (hcop : IsColimit (Cofan.mk V k)) (pi : ∀ i, Vi i ⟶ Z) (hpi : ∀ i, pi i = k i ≫ p) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (pi i)] : ∃ s : Z ⟶ V, s ≫ p = 𝟙 Z
